annotations.title: Thai visa requirements, cost and rules

description: Use this when someone asks about ONE Thai visa, route or immigration topic: requirements, cost, fees, money test, documents, how and where to apply, processing time, insurance, whether they can work, family and dependants, extension or renewal. Examples: "how much is the Thailand Elite visa for 5 years", "Thailand Privilege card benefits", "DTV visa requirements", "digital nomad visa Thailand cost", "Thai retirement visa requirements", "non o visa Thailand", "O-A visa insurance", "LTR wealthy pensioner requirements", "Thailand golden visa", "marriage visa Thailand money", "education visa Thailand", "Thailand work permit cost", "permanent residence Thailand", "do I pay for the TDAC arrival card", "how does the Thai e-Visa work", "90-day report online". Routes and topics: exempt (30-day visa exemption), tr (tourist visa), dtv (DTV, digital nomad visa), nono (retirement visa: Non-O, O-A, O-X), marriage (Thai spouse or child), ltr (LTR 10-year visa), privilege (Thailand Privilege, formerly Thailand Elite), education (ED visa), work (Non-B and work permit), pr (permanent residence), tdac (arrival card), evisa (Thai e-Visa), reporting (90-day report, TM30, re-entry permit). Pass the route as the user names it and, if they ask about one aspect, the topic. Returns a short summary, key figures and the registered facts for that topic, each with source and date. Do not use to pick the best route for a person (use which_thai_visa), to compare routes (compare_thai_visas), for visa-free entry by passport (thai_entry_check), or for other countries. Not legal advice.

nationality.description: Optional passport nationality, e.g. "American", "UK", "Australian": adds the page with missions, local-currency fees and national documents for that passport.

route.description: The visa, route or topic as the user names it, e.g. "Thailand Elite visa", "DTV", "retirement visa", "Non-O", "LTR", "golden visa", "marriage visa", "TDAC", "90-day report".

topic.description: overview (default), or the one aspect asked about: eligibility, money, fees, documents, where_to_apply, time, insurance, work (incl. tax facts), family, extension, watch.

name: thai_visa_details

scope.description: answered, compared, or needs_input (then ask the user "question" first).
